title: Epic: Advanced Craft — routes, constraints, reharmonization, and practice
description:
## Background
This milestone composes the same trusted laws/corpus/time/voice services into the ambitious Harmonic Discovery workbenches selected by the focused Idea Wizard.

## Goals
- Progression-level voicing, MIDI, route search, constraint harmonization, proof-carrying branches.
- Guide-tone and contextual color work, cadence/rhythm/tension transforms.
- Motif/sequence and honest nonfunctional/common-tone transforms.
- Deterministic chart-to-practice engine and all discovery/workbench UI.
- Curated lessons, prompts, help, and full mobile workflows.

## Included plan packages
V2, E1, G3-G9, U6, U7, U9-U11, D1.

## Guardrails
Search uses deterministic state/work-quanta/memory caps and cooperative yielding; wall time never changes musical output. Preview/search/branches are nonmutating. Every Apply is one exact-timing revision-checked command. No hidden worker, model, or network dependency.

## Epic exit
All fifteen Idea Wizard capabilities are usable and individually traceable to conformance/E2E/limit/evidence artifacts; MIDI and every advanced workflow preserve the core musical/data/audio invariants.

title: V2: Bounded progression voicing optimizer
description:
## Background
Reviewed package V2 turns event-local legal voicings into a deterministic progression-level realization service shared by playback, MIDI, constraints, and the voice-leading workbench.

## Required implementation
Implement the resumable optimizer over V1 motion/cost vectors and V0 candidates. Respect Manual/Frozen event boundaries, locks, bass/range/family constraints, exact source event IDs, 96 raw and 24 retained candidates per event, beam width 48, and a 512-event chart cap. Return Pareto alternatives, selected realization IDs, degradation/conflict explanations, SearchStats, and explicit termination.

## Determinism and bounds
Search advances only by fixed work quanta with stable ordering/tie-breaks and cooperative yielding; wall-clock time is measurement, never a semantic cutoff. Enforce state/memory/work-quanta caps and distinguish complete, exhausted, cancelled, and work-quanta-cap results. Never mutate the document or silently relax a hard constraint.

## Success criteria
Identical input/version/profile yields byte-identical alternatives across yield schedules. Small cases equal exhaustive brute force. Manual/Frozen pitches survive exactly, boundaries are honored, and every degraded/no-result outcome names the responsible constraints.

## Test and evidence
Add brute-force oracle tests, seeded/metamorphic determinism, 96/24/48/512 bound cases, cancellation/resume/yield-schedule equivalence, impossible locks/ranges, Manual/Frozen seams, Pareto dominance, memory/work counters, and performance observations at 100 ms interactive and 500 ms large-chart targets without using those clocks to select output.

## Non-goals
No stochastic model, hidden relaxation, factorial assignment, UI, audio scheduling, or MIDI byte writing.

title: U6: Progression voice-leading workbench
description:
## Background
This is reviewed plan package U6 in the Advanced Craft milestone and completes a user-facing portion of the deterministic product contract.

## Required implementation
Expose V2 with current/alternative realization lanes, exact pitches/roles, motion and cost axes, bass/guide summaries, Manual/Frozen boundaries, locks, family/range/bass controls, Pareto/degradation/conflict/search status, keyboard/touch selection, exact per-event audition via X1, ephemeral A/B and one revision-checked freeze/Apply command.

## Invariants and risks
Search never edits while running; audition never changes document selection or playhead; Manual pitches are immutable; wall-time display never changes results; every visual has labels and nonvisual equivalents.

## Success criteria
Users can understand changes, lock/freeze, compare/cancel/resume, hear exact pitches and Apply/Undo with stable timing/identity at mobile and 200 percent zoom.

## Test plan and detailed logging
E2E audition, lock/freeze, Manual seams, Pareto selection, cancellation/resume, stale Apply, A/B/global Stop/Undo; keyboard/screen-reader, focus, 320px/forced colors/reduced motion, exact pitch and leak logs.

## Non-goals
No notation engraving, drag-only pitch editing, or UI-owned voicing algorithm. Preserve unrelated work.

title: U7: MIDI export workflow
description:
## Background
This is reviewed plan package U7 in the Advanced Craft milestone and completes a user-facing portion of the deterministic product contract.

## Required implementation
Provide accessible dialog/sheet with readiness, selected realization, PPQ/tempo/meter/tracks, bass policy, spelling/annotation losses, blocked events, safe filename, deterministic hash, Generate/Download/Cancel and links to unresolved voicings. Generate only the current validated revision and clean all object URLs.

## Invariants and risks
Do not claim notation preservation, auto-fix voicings, download stale bytes, call recovery Save, or require a pointer. Cancellation/failure must not update document/export markers incorrectly.

## Success criteria
Users can inspect omissions, resolve blockers, generate independently parsed-valid bytes and repeat deterministically on desktop/mobile/keyboard/screen reader.

## Test plan and detailed logging
Browser E2E success/cancel/blocker/stale/failure/cleanup/filename/external bass/loss disclosure, focus/live region, 320px/zoom/forced colors and golden byte/hash assertions.

## Non-goals
No MIDI import, device playback, cloud sharing, or DAW templates. Preserve unrelated work.

description:

This is reviewed plan package U11 in the Advanced Craft milestone and completes a user-facing portion of the deterministic product contract.

Every template completes pointer-free, grades reproducibly, explains mistakes, handles ambiguous answers and serializes/reloads as designed; audio globally stops and progress has nonvisual status.

title: G3: Goal-directed Harmonic Route Planner
description:
## Background
This is reviewed plan package G3 in the Advanced Craft milestone and implements a selected deterministic Idea Wizard capability.

## Required implementation
Search lawful routes of at most 8 events and 64 outgoing candidates per state between validated endpoints. Accept context, law/evidence tiers, pins, length/rhythm/range and ranking constraints. Use fixed-work-quanta search capped at 50,000 states and 64 MiB. Return exact symbols/realizations, proof chain, evidence/counterevidence, cost vector, voice motion, identity, stats, termination and nonmutating patch.

## Invariants and risks
No runtime AI, wall-time semantic cutoff, probability theater, hidden relaxation or unlabeled enharmonic reinterpretation. Revalidate source revision before Apply; zero/capped results remain explicit and useful.

## Success criteria
Small graphs match exhaustive Pareto routes; endpoints and hard constraints always hold; resume/yield schedules are byte-identical and route identities dedupe stably.

## Test plan and detailed logging
Tonicization, secondary dominant, tritone substitution, modal interchange, diminished/common-tone pivots, ambiguity, unreachable endpoints, pins, all caps, cancellation/resume, stale Apply, transposition/metamorphic laws and browser responsiveness logs. Log stable identities, inputs, limits, termination and exact diffs without leaking chart content unnecessarily.

## Non-goals
No free-form composition model, melody generator, universal best-route claim, or UI. Preserve unrelated work.

title: G4: Constraint Harmonization Workbench engine
description:
## Background
This is reviewed plan package G4 in the Advanced Craft milestone and implements a selected deterministic Idea Wizard capability.

## Required implementation
Compile typed melody, bass, chord, rhythm, range, style and endpoint constraints into legal candidates via T1/G0/G2/V2. Support 16 slots, 128 candidates per slot and 100,000 states with fixed work quanta. Separate hard constraints from soft cost axes; return Pareto solutions or actionable conflict sets, stats, termination and exact revision-checked patch.

## Invariants and risks
Never invent coverage for an impossible note, silently reinterpret spelling, relax pins, merge hard/soft requirements, mutate during search, or confuse literal identity with contextual reading.

## Success criteria
Small spaces equal brute-force enumeration; every solution satisfies every hard constraint; unsatisfiable cases identify the actual conflicting slots/rules; cancellation/resume/yield order is deterministic.

## Test plan and detailed logging
Independent brute-force oracle; melody/bass/spelling near misses, contradictory pins, exact rhythm, Manual/Frozen, plural/no context, 16/128/100k bounds, memory counters, transposition, ties, cancellation, stale patch and performance observation. Log stable identities, inputs, limits, termination and exact diffs without leaking chart content unnecessarily.

## Non-goals
No audio transcription, melody extraction, probabilistic inference, or UI. Preserve unrelated work.

title: G7: Cadence, phrase, harmonic-rhythm, and tension-curve transforms
description:
## Background
This is reviewed plan package G7 in the Advanced Craft milestone and implements selected deterministic Idea Wizard capabilities.

## Required implementation
Detect phrase/cadence opportunities from G0/H1 with strict positive/near-miss rules. Emit exact TransformLaw patches for supported approaches, turnarounds, backdoor/secondary/diminished setups, anticipation, delay, split/merge, augmentation/diminution and metric displacement. Compute a deterministic tension curve from named axes: function, dissonance, voice motion, register, harmonic rhythm and context confidence.

## Invariants and risks
Preserve exact BeatValue and measure accounting unless the explicit bounded request changes them. Do not label cadence from roots alone, insert hidden rests, apply near-miss rules or portray tension as musical quality.

## Test plan and detailed logging
Cadence positives/near misses; exact-time properties across meters for every rhythm transform; component/mutation/transposition tests for curves; pickup/incomplete measures, Manual/Frozen boundaries, stale/nonmutating patches, deterministic ranks and caps. Log identities, evidence, limits, termination and exact diffs.

## Non-goals
No beat tracking from audio, genre-authenticity claim, or UI. Preserve unrelated work.

title: G8: Motif, sequence, and nonfunctional transformation atlas
description:
## Background
This is reviewed plan package G8 in the Advanced Craft milestone and implements selected deterministic Idea Wizard capabilities.

## Required implementation
Extract typed motifs and generate bounded diatonic, chromatic and intervallic sequences with exact target landings, spelling policy, rhythm preservation and proof chain. Add explicitly limited common-tone, planing, chromatic-mediant and neo-Riemannian P/L/R laws on eligible triads with preserved tones, exact voice motion and refusal outside domain.

## Invariants and risks
Do not infer motifs from arbitrary repetition, apply P/L/R to seventh/custom/unsupported sonorities, overclaim functional explanation, lose enharmonic rationale or ignore landing/range/measure constraints. Every variant passes normal parser/resolver/validation laws.

## Success criteria
Transforms land exactly or refuse, preserve declared rhythm/common tones, state relation/domain/limitations, dedupe by stable identity and obey declared transpose/inverse laws.

## Test plan and detailed logging
Motif false positives; diatonic/chromatic sequences and landing failures; meters/ranges; P/L/R truth tables and ineligible near misses; common-tone/planing/mediant goldens, spelling alternatives, inverse/metamorphic/transposition, deterministic bounds and mutation tests. Log identities, evidence, limits, termination and exact diffs.

## Non-goals
No Schenkerian-analysis claim, arbitrary graph embedding, style imitation, or UI. Preserve unrelated work.

Implement separate ChartTextParser for headers, sections, JSON-string annotations, bars, repeats, :p/q durations, deterministic bar allocation, partial-token insertion, and canonical text export.

## Invariants and risks
Do not use substring classification or let a failed/unknown suffix become major. Parsed sourceText must reparse to its AST; structured edits canonicalize. Undurated divisions must be exact divisors of 960 or diagnose. Partial chart commit is forbidden; one-token insertion states its lost layout context.

## Success criteria
All mandatory symbols and chart examples parse/format canonically; failures preserve source/ranges/did-you-mean without guessing; parse(format(parse(x))) and chart export/import laws pass across ASCII/Unicode and malformed corpora.

## Test plan and detailed logging
Create grammar goldens plus seeded property/metamorphic tests for aliases, modifier order/conflicts, C9/C13 token drift, 6/9/slash ambiguity, section escapes, annotations, headers, repeats, empty/over/underfilled bars, representable/nonrepresentable durations, and formatter idempotence. Log source tokens/ranges on failure.

## Non-goals
Do not implement downstream UI/audio/discovery features here or weaken the reviewed contracts to make a narrow test pass. Preserve unrelated work.

title: V1: Implement exact noncrossing pairwise voice assignment
description:
## Background
This is reviewed plan package V1 in Musical Intelligence. It expands the trusted editor with deterministic, evidence-bearing theory rather than opaque recommendation.

## Required implementation
Implement deterministic order-preserving sequence-alignment DP for 3-7 voices with explicit entering/leaving gaps, stable request-local voice IDs/ordinals, degree provenance, exact/pitch-class/spelled identity distinctions, and VoiceArc endpoints. Propagate IDs on matches, allocate entering IDs, forbid crossing by construction, and return plural motion costs without string-prefix matching.

## Invariants and risks
Entering/leaving semitones are null, not zero. Octave common tone, exact sustained identity, and spelled identity are distinct questions. Workbench locks bind request/event/voice/pitch/degree and invalidate on request change. Do not use factorial “Hungarian” enumeration or a separable crossing cost that cannot represent crossings.

## Success criteria
DP matches brute force for small order-preserving cases; IDs/arcs/costs deterministic; common/oblique/contrary/enter/leave and guide-tone facts exact; C never matches C#; typed no-assignment conditions visible.

## Test plan and detailed logging
Unit/property tests for differing voice counts, all equality modes, crossing counterexamples, repeated pitch classes/octaves, ties, stable IDs, guide degrees, null semitones, C/C# regression, brute-force oracle, and mutation tests. Log matrices/path/backtrace on failure.

## Non-goals
No runtime AI, network, universal musical-quality score, hidden constraint relaxation, or implementation-generated authority. Do not oversimplify away ambiguity, proof, limits, or alternatives. Preserve unrelated work.

title: G0: Implement phrase analysis and k-best Tonal Journey paths
description:
## Background
This is reviewed plan package G0 in Musical Intelligence. It expands the trusted editor with deterministic, evidence-bearing theory rather than opaque recommendation.

## Required implementation
Build pure deterministic phrase/cadence feature extraction and bounded k-best sequence analysis over major/minor/mode tonic contexts plus tonicization, modal/nonfunctional, no-key, and unclassified states. Score with typed evidence/counterevidence from literal match, duration/metric emphasis, neighbor resolution, cadence, and section assertions. Return five non-dominated paths with key-area spans, pivots, modulation boundaries, phrase/cadence roles, missing evidence, and user-pinnable reading IDs.

## Invariants and risks
This is plural analysis, not key detection truth. It cannot silently persist context, force planing into functional labels, use wall time semantically, or collapse ambiguous paths. Use resumable deterministic work quanta for long charts.

## Success criteria
Same chart/versions yields identical paths/order/stats; pinned/no-key ranges respected; positive/near-miss cadences and pivots classified honestly; 256 events meet performance gate without blocking UI runner.

## Test plan and detailed logging
tests/conformance/tonal-journey.test.ts and tonal-ambiguity tests across modulations, tonicizations, modal vamps, planing, ordinary/secondary dominants, pivot alternatives, missing key, section overrides, transposition, caps/degraded/stale/cancel, and five-path determinism.

## Non-goals
No runtime AI, network, universal musical-quality score, hidden constraint relaxation, or implementation-generated authority. Do not oversimplify away ambiguity, proof, limits, or alternatives. Preserve unrelated work.

title: Epic: Reliable Studio — author, recover, import, play, and stop
description:
## Background
This milestone turns the trustworthy core into a real progression editor and eliminates the legacy data-loss, touch, transport, preview, and stale-audio failures.

## Goals
- Command/history state with stable-ID selection and transactional replacement.
- Recovery, canonical/legacy import/export, lead-sheet chart editing, inspector, piano.
- Exact local voicing and playback plans.
- One lazy persistent Web Audio graph with serialized transport and strict no-future-attack Stop.
- Responsive accessible shell, real preview, transport, and lifecycle dialogs.

## Included plan packages
A0, A1, C0, P0, V0, X0, X1, E0, U0, U1, U2, U4, U5.

## Guardrails
No UI calls audio/storage directly; no import applies before confirmation; manual/custom pitches remain exact; preview is nonmutating; document replacement retires all audio generations before publish; all UI/audio integration waits on X1 stop-safety.

## Epic exit
A user can create/edit/reorder/undo/recover/migrate/import/export JSON or chart text and reliably preview/play/pause/seek/stop/replay on keyboard, pointer, and touch, with failure E2E and no stale audio.

### U2: Build semantic chord inspector, exact piano, and real preview

## Background
This is reviewed plan package U2 in the Reliable Studio milestone. It must eliminate a documented legacy failure class while preserving the Foundation contracts.

## Required implementation
Implement progressive Symbol/Structure/Timing/Voicing/Harmony/Motion/Notes inspector over draft AST; parse/canonical diagnostics; degree/pitch/bass/omission display; exact timing; Auto/Manual/Frozen switching with confirmation; semantic structured edits; annotation; MIDI-coordinate piano with spelling/octave/accessibility and list/spin alternative; real audio Preview through X1/X0 without selection/document/playhead mutation.

Custom/unsupported text is never overwritten by a guess; root/modifier edits cannot retain stale notes; manual exact MIDI duplicates reject while octave doubling can remain; Auto→Manual copies realized notes, Manual→Auto requires policy; malformed annotations are inert text. Do not substitute mocks where this package names real adapters/audio/browser behavior, and do not weaken exact musical/data semantics to make UI integration easier. Preserve unrelated work.

title: U4: Build transport controls and truthful audio status
description:
## Background
This is reviewed plan package U4 in the Reliable Studio milestone. It must eliminate a documented legacy failure class while preserving the Foundation contracts.

## Required implementation
Implement previous/next, play/pause, global Stop, separate Restart, loop scope, accessible exact scrubber, BPM input/steps, instrument, count-in/metronome, current chord/time, locked/ready/playing/paused/interrupted/unavailable/fault status, keyboard Space/Shift+Space guards, and generation-tagged projection from X1. Instrument changes expose effective boundary; Stop returns to run start.

## Invariants and risks
UI never schedules sound or advances playhead. Initial state must not show playing. Shortcuts are inactive in edit fields. Audio failure cannot block editing/export. Stale generation notifications cannot repaint controls.

## Success criteria
All transport actions match state machine on mouse/touch/keyboard/screen reader; BPM/scrub/loop/instrument are real; interrupted/fault recovery is actionable; mobile bottom bar remains visible and safe-area correct.

## Test plan and detailed logging
E2E initial-transport, play/pause/seek/stop/restart/loop/BPM/instrument/section-play/shortcut field guards/interruption/fault/stale notification/mobile layouts with real browser AudioContext subset and console/state event logs.

## Non-goals
Do not substitute mocks where this package names real adapters/audio/browser behavior, and do not weaken exact musical/data semantics to make UI integration easier. Preserve unrelated work.

title: A1: Implement recovery persistence and document lifecycle
description:
## Background
This is reviewed plan package A1 in the Reliable Studio milestone. It must eliminate a documented legacy failure class while preserving the Foundation contracts.

## Required implementation
Implement IndexedDB primary and bounded localStorage fallback adapters, capability/quota probes, current/previous RecoveryEnvelope with checksum, revision, export hash/revision/time, 400 ms idle and two-second max write scheduling, revision-safe completion, startup Keep/Discard/fallback flow, and exact Recovery/Changed since export vocabulary. Browser recovery is never called Save.

## Invariants and risks
Editing must continue when storage is denied/quota/corruption occurs. Unload completion is best-effort only. Older write completion cannot mark/overwrite newer state. Recovery may not initialize audio or overwrite an edited in-memory document.

## Success criteria
Valid current/previous recovery, corruption, stale/export conflict, unavailable/quota, rapid mutation, reload, discard, and export-marker behavior match the contract with actionable status and no data loss.

## Test plan and detailed logging
Fake adapter/clock integration plus browser reload E2E under IndexedDB, forced failure, localStorage fallback, quota, corrupt current/valid previous, stale completion, export cancellation/success, and visibility-change. Log revisions/hashes/adapter transitions without chart text.

## Non-goals
Do not substitute mocks where this package names real adapters/audio/browser behavior, and do not weaken exact musical/data semantics to make UI integration easier. Preserve unrelated work.

## Required implementation
Create one AudioContext lazily in a user gesture and one persistent graph: per-voice envelopes→instrument bus/filter/EQ→dry/reverb send with fixed-seed impulse→conservative compressor→measured soft-clip safety→master. Implement five honest synth recipes, SynthVoice lifecycle, generation/event/pitch-indexed ActiveVoiceRegistry, idempotent cleanup, note-off-before-note-on, normalization, polyphony/stealing, preview/progression ownership, and debug counts.

## Invariants and risks
Never close/recreate context for ordinary actions, bypass effects for sections/previews, use anonymous delayed callbacks, claim compressor is a limiter, load samples/CDNs, or let cleanup reconnect/dispose another generation. Reverb algorithm checksum/license inventory must be deterministic.

## Success criteria
